Some sugar is contaminated with glass.
How is a sample of solid sugar obtained from the mixture?
A
dissolve in water and then evaporate
B
dissolve in water, then filter and then dry the solid residue
C
dissolve in water, then filter and evaporate the filtrate
D
dissolve in water and then distil
